## Line 369

**Source:** [stdlib/geometry/polygons.library.plato, line 369](../../../../../stdlib/geometry/polygons.library.plato#L369).

```plato

    // The query projected onto the polygon's plane when that projection lands
    // inside the ring, otherwise the nearest point of the boundary. Exact for any
    // simple planar polygon, convex or not.
    ClosestPoint(p: Polygon3D, point: Point3D): Point3D
    {
        var normal = p.Points.VectorArea.Normalize;
        var origin = p.Points.First;
        var projected = point - normal * origin.Between(point).Dot(normal);
        return p.Points.PlanarPolygonContains(normal, projected)
            ? projected
            : p.Points.ClosestPointOnChain(true, point);
    }
```
